# gdk-pixbuf / pixbuf_cons_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `pixbuf_cons_fuzzer` ([source](source/pixbuf_cons_fuzzer.c), unmodified) over gdk-pixbuf (gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gdk-pixbuf at 8c294250).

Requires >= 800 input bytes and uses them as the pixel bytes of a 10x20, 3-channel, rowstride-40 pixbuf, then runs scale_simple, rotate_simple, flip, composite_color_simple, set_option/get_option with the input as key and value, new_from_data and a second flip; every result is unref'd unread (get_option's return value is stored but never compared with what was set).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against gdk-pixbuf at commit 8c294250 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
